name: vest
description: Vest - Fractional Real Estate Investment Platform in Mongolia

scripts.db:setup: echo '📋 Database Setup Instructions:' && echo '1. Go to Supabase Dashboard > SQL Editor' && echo '2. Run: pnpm db:copy-schema (then paste & run in SQL Editor)' && echo '3. Run: pnpm db:copy-functions (then paste & run)' && echo '4. Run: pnpm db:copy-auth-sync (then paste & run)' && echo '5. Run: pnpm db:copy-seed (optional, then paste & run)' && echo '' && echo 'See README.DATABASE.md for detailed instructions.'
scripts.db:copy-schema: cat schema.sql | pbcopy && echo '✅ Schema copied to clipboard! Paste in Supabase SQL Editor and click Run.'
scripts.db:copy-functions: cat migrations/001_stored_procedures.sql | pbcopy && echo '✅ Stored procedures copied to clipboard! Paste in Supabase SQL Editor and click Run.'
scripts.db:copy-auth-sync: cat migrations/002_auth_sync_trigger.sql | pbcopy && echo '✅ Auth sync trigger copied to clipboard! Paste in Supabase SQL Editor and click Run.'
scripts.db:copy-seed: cat supabase/seed.sql | pbcopy && echo '✅ Seed data copied to clipboard! Paste in Supabase SQL Editor and click Run.'
scripts.db:migrate: echo '⚠️  For Supabase, use: pnpm db:copy-schema' && echo 'Or set DATABASE_URL in .env and use: psql $DATABASE_URL -f schema.sql'
scripts.db:functions: echo '⚠️  For Supabase, use: pnpm db:copy-functions' && echo 'Or set DATABASE_URL in .env and use: psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/001_stored_procedures.sql'
scripts.db:auth-sync: echo '⚠️  For Supabase, use: pnpm db:copy-auth-sync' && echo 'Or set DATABASE_URL in .env and use: psql $DATABASE_URL -f migrations/002_auth_sync_trigger.sql'
scripts.db:seed: echo '⚠️  For Supabase, use: pnpm db:copy-seed' && echo 'Or set DATABASE_URL in .env and use: psql $DATABASE_URL -f supabase/seed.sql'
